_comment: Hand-authored candidate set for the Phase-9 dollar-ranked queue contract (Plan 09-01, Wave 1 RED).
Each row carries the raw components the ranker's weekly-$ estimator needs, NOT a precomputed estimate:
the rank_queue test rebuilds the expected weekly $ from these components (the test_tacos _pct-mirror
pattern, T-09-01-03 mitigation) so a fabricated estimate cannot pass review unnoticed.
Sanitized component sums only — no seller UUID, no network, no live ids.
ESTIMATE MODEL (the ranker implements this in Wave 3, Plan 03): a spend-up's expected incremental
weekly sales $ = delta_spend_weekly / window_acos_fraction, where window_acos_fraction =
ad_spend_sum / ad_sales_sum over the cited window. A zero/missing ad_sales_sum (zero denominator)
means the ACOS is undefined -> expected_weekly_usd is None (NOT 0, NOT a guess), and that row sorts
LAST (the D-07 None-sorts-last key). Reversible spend-DOWN rows have delta_spend_weekly <= 0.
SKUs are real CA fixture SKUs (mirror profit_by_sku_30d.csv) so the contract reads as production-shaped.
